mapper.update: UPDATE pet_info SET pet_name = #{pet_name}, pet_age = #{pet_age}, pet_birthday = CASE WHEN #{pet_birthday} IS NOT NULL AND #{pet_birthday} != '' THEN TO_DATE(#{pet_birthday}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ELSE pet_birthday END, pet_gender = #{pet_gender}, pet_species = #{pet_species}, pet_breed = #{pet_breed} WHERE user_no = #{user_no} AND pet_no = #{pet_no}
